self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Magic Affinity (R5): after using an Elemental Skill, increases Normal and Charged Attack DMG by 16% for 12s, max 2 stacks. Modeled at max stacks: +32% Normal/Charged Attack DMG.

en.flavor: A hooked spear discovered hidden away in the Blackcliff Forge. The glimmers along the sharp edge are like stars in the night.
